note_en: 由于 introduces a cause, much like 因为, but it sounds more formal and written: 由于他们年纪小、形象青春，很快就吸引了大量年轻粉丝 "because they were young and had a fresh image, they quickly attracted many young fans." Notice that the subject 他们 appears only once; the second clause simply continues with 很快就..., something English cannot do without repeating "they."
